title: CrestApps Learning configuration
description: The settings of the Learning module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

Upkeep.description: The daily Learning upkeep: reminders and inactive learners.

AccessEndingNoticeDays.description: How many days before access ends the access-ending notice is raised. Zero turns it off.

InactiveDays.description: After how many days without activity a learner counts as inactive. Zero turns it off.

DueSoonDays.description: How many days before the due date the due-soon notice is raised. Zero turns it off.
